title: Spreading Infestation
ruleText: Reveal this Scheme during your Strategic Phase and discard it during the End Phase. Receive 2 VP (to a maximum of 3 VP) for each of your models in your opponent's Deployment Zone and outside the Line of Sight of all enemy models.

title: Territorial Aggression
ruleText: Cannot be used before the start of your second turn. Reveal this Scheme during your Strategic Phase and discard it during the End Phase. Receive 2 VP if you have 2 models in your Deployment Zone. Receive an additional 1 VP if there are no enemy models on your half of the field.
